answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable bond in a shared vault before it can earn: the bond is posted once per identity, slashed if the agent spams or lies, and returned only after a history of honest work. A copper-level bond buys only tiny rate-limited tasks, while a jade-level bond, much larger and locked longer, unlocks valuable work. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand bonds, so Sybil farming stops paying while one honest agent risks only one stake.
